title: Asking about other musicians: Warner, Lewis, Klim, the Franks
summary: Interviewers ask about Willie Warner, Frank Lewis, Baltimore, Edward Klim and the Frank brothers; Jones remembers few, with Klim a good clarinetist less of a rag player than Bolden. Jones's wife says the questioning is puzzling him.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
